description: Cloud communications platform providing APIs for messaging, voice, email, and verification
auth_notes: Authenticate using HTTP Basic Authentication with your Account SID and Auth Token, or via Twilio API keys.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free account/trial instantly online without a credit card to obtain credentials.
api_notes: Extensive REST APIs covering SMS, MMS, WhatsApp, Voice, Lookup, Verify, Conversations, and TaskRouter.
mcp_notes: No official vendor-published MCP server found in documentation, though community integrations may exist.
rationale: Twilio offers comprehensive REST APIs, official SDKs, and self-serve free trial credentials that allow developers to build immediately.

evidence.note: Describes API keys and authentication methods for Twilio REST APIs.
Details sign up for free trial without a credit card.
Explains REST API structure and usage across Twilio products.

open_questions: Whether an official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server will be released by Twilio in the near future.
